subject_line: An Author Spotlight for Curtain Call
email_body:
Hi Mark,

I came across Curtain Call, the 2025 instalment in your Nicholas Sharp thriller series, and the premise of a former marine sniper turned musician caught in a staged attack at an Independence Day concert stood out to me. It is a distinctive blend of the music world and high stakes action, and it clearly draws on your own years in the music industry.

I would love to invite you to be featured in an Author Spotlight on The Author Ledger. The feature is designed to introduce readers to your work, the story behind your book, and the experiences or ideas that have shaped your journey as an author.

Alongside our editorial features, we also support authors with professionally produced audiobook editions, cinematic book trailers, short promotional reels, author websites, press kits, Amazon A+ graphics, and book relaunch materials.

With a series as cinematic as Nicholas Sharp, a short trailer or a few promotional reels for Curtain Call could be a natural fit. If that is something you have been considering, we can handle the full production, and it would be entirely optional alongside the feature.

The Author Spotlight is a paid feature, and I would be happy to share the details and pricing if it sounds like a good fit.

Would you be interested in hearing more about the feature and the option I believe would suit Curtain Call best?

Warm regards,
Oseni Ibrahim
The Author Ledger
